svg.title: P2PKH address construction
svg.desc: Bob's public key goes through HASH160, SHA256 then RIPEMD160, to give a 20-byte public-key hash. A Base58Check bracket groups prepending the mainnet version byte 0x00, calculating the checksum with two SHA256 rounds and keeping the first four bytes, appending it, and Base58 encoding all 25 bytes into an address beginning with 1, 26 to 34 characters long.
